oracle.derivation: A 1000-section RC ladder. Converged reference: Xyce at timeint reltol 1e-6, nonlinear reltol 1e-7 abstol 1e-15; the previous oracle (ngspice at the deck's options) was 99.5x its tolerance off it. Samples: of 187 rows, 0 dropped on fast edges (within one TSTEP, 1e-09 s, either way the waveform moves more than a tenth of its swing, a default-options run misses by more than the tolerance, and a time shift within that TSTEP meets this value) and 0 where a default-options run is off by more than 1% of the column's swing (not settled for it); 187 kept. Each atol is 2x the largest deviation beyond rtol*|value| of ngspice-44.2 at the deck's options, Xyce 7.10.0 at its defaults, ngspice-44.2 at reltol 1e-7 from this reference on the rows kept, or the previous atol where larger.

confirmed.command: ngspice -b deck + .options reltol=1e-7 abstol=1e-15 vntol=1e-12 chgtol=1e-20, .tran tmax 4e-11
